tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen and the gaps between cards.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, app bar, tab bar, side rail, sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised inside a card: item slots, inputs, list rows, chips, the segmented control's track.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Selected or pressed rows, the active segment, hover.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, empty-slot dashes. Decoration only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls (inputs, secondary buttons, slots that accept a drop) and the sheet's top edge. 3:1 on ground and every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3 and every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, timestamps, inactive tab icons, on ground and surface-1/2/3 (5.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Value and action: the one primary button per screen, the active tab, gold amounts, level badges, +4 to +6 upgrade marks. As text on ground, surfaces and gold-soft.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button, level badge border, the selected character's card edge. Not for text.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind gold or ink text: level badges, gold balance, the active rail item, unspent points.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold or gold-deep fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: essence
tokens.usage: Absorption only: absorbed traits, absorption progress, magical trait tags, the absorb line in the loot feed. As text on ground, surfaces and essence-soft.

tokens.name: essence-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind essence text: magical trait tags.

tokens.name: on-essence
tokens.usage: Text on an essence fill.

tokens.name: hp
tokens.usage: Health bar fill on bar-track (3.5:1). A fill only: red text is danger.

tokens.name: mana
tokens.usage: Mana bar fill; mana values as text on ground, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: xp
tokens.usage: Experience bar fill and XP gains in the loot feed; as text on ground and surfaces.

tokens.name: bar-track
tokens.usage: The empty part of every resource and progress bar.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Farming status, full drop rate, successful upgrade. Always with an icon and a word: it is close to danger in lightness.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Travelling and returning status, running timers, neutral notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Mini-bosses, reduced drop rate, weapon attribute penalty, return triggers about to fire (bag nearly full, few potions).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Dead status, bosses, 0% drop rate, destroy-on-fail warnings, destructive buttons; as text on ground, surfaces and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger text: destroy warnings, the danger button.

tokens.name: arcane
tokens.usage: The rare: rare items, cursed objects, the rare goods shop, +7 to +9 upgrade marks. As text on ground, surfaces and arcane-soft.

tokens.name: arcane-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind arcane text: rare item slots and the rare goods tile.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: 2px solid outline, 2px offset. 7:1 or more on ground and every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Cinzel, from Google Fonts. Proper names and titles only, never numbers, buttons or body, never below 17px.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Desktop screen titles and the offline summary headline.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Phone screen titles in the app bar; the character name on desktop detail.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles: character, area, enemy, shop and item names.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Barlow, from Google Fonts. Everything a player reads as sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Kaela returned to the city: bag full.
styles.usage: Default text, button labels (at 600), sheet copy.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines in cards, loot feed text, help under controls.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Barlow Semi Condensed with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so columns of numbers line up.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, bar labels, chips and tags. Set with text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: Hero numbers: upgrade success chance, offline totals.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Values in rows: stats, gold per hour, timers, bag counts.

styles.name: number-sm
styles.usage: Stack counts and upgrade marks on slots, level badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to bar, icon to its number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and buttons; between stacked bars.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards on phones; between slot groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone screen gutters and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections inside a sheet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutters and gaps between columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop section spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of summary screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Level badges, tags, upgrade marks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, item slots, inputs, the segmented control, avatars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; desktop dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Resource bars, status chips, the gold balance.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows: only floating layers cast one.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets on phones, over scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Desktop dialogs, menus and the proficiency notice.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the layout depends on.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-slot
tokens.usage: One inventory or warehouse cell. Seven columns with 6px gaps fit a 390px phone with space-4 gutters.

tokens.name: size-appbar
tokens.usage: Phone app bar height.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Phone bottom tab bar height, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Desktop navigation rail width.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Widest the desktop content gets.

breakpoint.note: Reference widths for media queries (custom properties cannot be used inside a media query, so copy the value).

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: The reference phone every screen is designed at first.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Cards go two-up; the inventory grid may widen to 9 columns.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Tab bar becomes the left rail; roster and character detail sit side by side; sheets become dialogs.
